results.title: Carlton Taylor Has Major Problems
results.overview: In the days before Christmas, Carlton Taylor has his life in perfect order. A meticulous textbook editor devoted to facts, structure, and the sanctity of the printed word, he has spent decades doing one thing well. Then a young CEO arrives to drag his longtime publishing house into an AI-driven future, and Carlton discovers exactly how disposable a lifetime of expertise can be.

results.title: White Guilt
results.overview: From civil rights warrior and black militant to fearless dissident, Shelby Steele unmasks white guilt as the toxin that poisoned America -- destroying merit, igniting riots, demolishing standards, and now arming global chaos from campus bloodlust to civilizational suicide.

results.title: The Frontier Under The Blood Moon
results.overview: The werewolf shaman from Sumo Mohe tribe ambushes the Buddhist maiden presented by Silla to the Tang Dynasty, attempting to sabotage their efforts to build friendly relations, only to run into the detective Di Renjie, who is handling a case at the border. Di joins forces with Sima Xiaodao and Doctor Duan to unravel the tribe's conspiracy, saving the nation from danger once again.

results.title: Passing Through
results.overview: Sam, a young adolescent, visits his older sister Lina in Marseille for the weekend.

results.title: Caballero Bonald. Fragmentos de navegante
results.overview: Caballero Bonald: Fragmentos de navegante is a meta-documentary that blends memory, fiction, and poetry in a journey between Spain and Colombia, in which an actor learns to portray the author at three different stages of his life, embarking on a reverse journey toward lost innocence—from the poet's final years back to his childhood.

results.title: A Date With Destiny
results.overview: Nate is becoming increasingly interested in the elusive mystery girl, Destiny. The two form a close relationship, which is tested when the involvement of Nate's stepbrother becomes troublesome. After a violent run-in, their love is put to the test.

results.title: The Sledge
results.overview: Three siblings accidentally damage their father’s sledge, the family’s main source of income. Determined to make things right, they set out to earn money to cover the damage. But when they find a bag full of cash, they face a difficult choice: keep it or return it to its rightful owner?

results.title: Two or three things I still have of hers
results.original_title: Dos o tres cosas que me quedé de ella
results.overview: One morning Nicolás wakes up to a letter from his girlfriend telling him that she's leaving him. Among the few things he still has of her is her cat, Ricardo. Disoriented and lost in the uncertainty, Nicolás will take the path that the people around him, the city and fate itself lead him on.

results.title: JINX
results.overview: After moving into her new home, Mia, a mute Girl, discovers a cursed dollhouse hidden in the attic. When her younger brother vanishes into thin air, she must unlock the relic's dark mysteries before the ancient hex claims his soul forever.
